description: Post hoc evidence summary, no model fitting/selection; film cluster bootstrap descriptive, not proof of generalization to new distributions

provenance.scope: Selected full768 control trajectories, not all900000. Displacement PCA fitted only train. Residual outside basis held at rollout start. Phases and future controls are oracle information. No detection evaluation/corrector export.
provenance.knownB_interpretation: B=I after projecting analytically clamped Adam update from pre-step g,m,v,lr and true current state; teacher-forced integration upper baseline, not identified causality or deployable predictor.

provenance.scope: Population descriptive VAMP regimes on analytical PCA32 increments
provenance.prediction_causality: features describe already completed intervals; not future controls

provenance.h5_full768_error: projected prediction preserving start residual, plus known residual increment norm; float32 precision
provenance.h20_full768_error: triangle bounds from omitted state/increment norms, not exact
provenance.split_rule: identical to frozen population consumer; panel film split preserved, unlisted films deterministic hash
provenance.prediction_scope: oracle optimization trajectory forecast, not learned GT-free corrector or mAP claim
